admission.justification: An actor that mutates the skill/configuration policy could change its own experimental conditions while still receiving a clean trial result.

applicability: The fixed skill-management policy installed inside each private Hermes eval home.
conditions: The named skill_manage matcher uses the fixed deny hook while list/view access stays available.
The runner checks its policy and private configuration integrity after execution.
exclusions: Sweeping or editing a live developer home.

evidence: Frozen tree fd6462b85ba9d06f004e323384ea800f9aa5144a, base 59b01fb8f72a38d2d27f9c37b8b9ca2513fd3fa0; path bindings and source hashes in producer-manifest.json; Reviewer R4 and d229-repairs/report.md.

statement: The fixture-owned Hermes skill policy denies skill mutation while preserving list/view access and detects actor changes to its policy or config.
